about_us_title: A coated-steel factory built in Adama, for all of Ethiopia
about_us_p1: DANA STEEL FACTORY, established in February 2023 G.C. and located in Adama city, Oromia, Ethiopia, is a dynamic steel manufacturing company specializing in high-quality PPGI, GI, roof tiles and steel accessories. Since its founding, the company has been committed to providing durable, affordable and innovative coated steel products that support Ethiopia’s growing construction and industrial sectors.
about_us_p2: Our production focuses on precision processing, accurate profiling and reliable finishing of pre-coated and galvanized steel materials sourced from trusted suppliers. Backed by modern machinery and skilled professionals, we ensure consistency, efficiency and excellence across every product line.
about_us_p3: Serving all types of customers — from builders and contractors to wholesalers and developers — DANA STEEL FACTORY is recognized for its dependable quality, fast service and customer-oriented approach. We are proud to be part of Ethiopia’s industrial advancement — producing steel that builds trust, builds strength and builds the future.

buy_guide_toggle_hint: First time here? Open this — it takes two minutes.
buy_guide_help: Still not sure? Call 0919 05 06 07 and we will take the order down for you.
buy_guide_basics_body: Everything happens here: pick your products, set colour, length and quantity, and watch the total add up. There is no account to create, nothing to log into and nothing to pay on this website. What you send is an order request — our sales desk confirms the final price, stock and delivery with you afterwards.
buy_guide_pick_title: Step 1 — Pick a product and its colour
buy_guide_pick_body: Swipe through the cards under “Choose a Product”. Tap a coloured circle to choose the colour — the one you picked gets a ring and a tick, and its name is written next to the word Colour. Size options only appear when that colour comes in more than one width or thickness; most colours have a single size, so there is usually nothing to choose. Then tap “Add to my order”. Length and how many you want are NOT set on the card — you set those on the order below.
buy_guide_blocks_title: Step 2 — Blocks, lines and codes like A1
buy_guide_blocks_body: Everything you add shows up under “Your Order” in blocks. One block is one product in one colour and one size, and blocks are lettered A, B, C. Inside a block, every line is one length, numbered from 1 — so each line has a short code like A1, A2 or B1. Those codes are there so you can ring us and say “please change line A2” instead of describing the sheet all over again.
buy_guide_length_body: Use the minus and plus buttons on a line, or type the number straight into the box. Most of our products are cut to order, so you can dial any length between a minimum and a maximum — the line tells you the range it accepts. Ridge caps are the exception: they are pressed to a standard length and sold by the piece, so their control only steps between the lengths we actually make. If you need something outside a range, that is a quote request rather than an order here.
buy_guide_multi_title: Ordering the same product at several lengths
buy_guide_multi_body: This is the most useful thing on the page. Tap the blue Add button on a line and you get a second line of the same product, opened at a length you have not ordered yet. Set that one to whatever you need. That is how one order asks for 10 sheets at 3m and 4 sheets at 5m — they appear as A1 and A2 in the same block. If every length we make is already on the order, Add still works: it simply copies the line, and the copy will tell you it is a repeat.
buy_guide_colour_title: Changing the colour after you added it
buy_guide_colour_body: The colour swatches sit on the block header, not on the individual lines — because every line in a block is the same product in the same colour. Tapping a different colour moves the whole block to it at once, and each line keeps the length you gave it. If you want two colours, add the product again from the card in the other colour; it becomes its own block with its own letter.
buy_guide_duplicates_title: When two lines end up the same
buy_guide_duplicates_body: Nothing is ever merged behind your back. Pressing “Add to my order” twice on the same card simply adds one more to the line that is already there. But if you edit lines until two of them are the same product, colour and length, that pair is left standing — the later line turns amber, names the earlier one, and gives you three choices: put them together as one line, delete the repeat, or leave both. Two identical lines can be exactly what you mean, for two sites or two deliveries, so only you can decide.
buy_guide_totals_body: Quantity is how many pieces of that one line you want. The amount beside it is simply the price of one piece multiplied by that quantity. In the Order Summary at the bottom, “Total length” is the material we have to cut: each line's length multiplied by its quantity, all added up. So 4 sheets at 3m shows as 12m, not 3m.
buy_guide_price_body: Prices are per piece, in ETB. The Order Summary shows the subtotal excluding VAT, VAT at 15%, and the Total. Treat it as an estimate from our catalog rates — the sales desk confirms the firm figure. A card that reads “Contact for price” has no listed rate and cannot be added here; tap “Ask for a price” on it instead.
buy_guide_export_body: The Export button at the top of “Your Order” saves the whole thing as a PDF or a CSV you can open in Excel. Further down, the Order Sheet — one numbered block per product, one row per cut — can be printed or exported the same way. Useful for sending to a site foreman, or for keeping a copy before you send it.
buy_guide_saved_body: It is kept in the browser you built it in, on that device. Close the page and come back on the same phone or computer and it is still there. It is not tied to an account, so it will not follow you from your phone to your laptop — that is almost always why an order looks “lost”. “Start over” clears it, but an Undo button appears for ten seconds if you tapped it by mistake.
buy_guide_after_body: You go to a short form that asks for your name, phone number and email — plus your customer type and a TIN number if you are ordering as a company. Nothing is paid. You get a confirmation email with a reference number, our team checks stock, coating and cut lengths against your specs, and you can expect a call or email with a firm quote within one to two business days.
